mechanism: EAs send intent JSON (symbol, sl_points, magic) to a localhost RiskGate Service; handler scans open positions, rejects if daily loss≥2% equity, ≥2 positions on symbol, or ≥6 daily trades; if another position shares the signal's magic correlation group, approved lot is halved before return. ATR(14)×4 supplies sl_points so lot risks a fixed 0.5% equity.
data_needed: Account equity/balance; deal history for day PnL; open positions by symbol/magic; ATR for SL distance; TCP JSON round-trip.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD,GBPUSD (magic 1000) and AUDUSD,NZDUSD (magic 1001); new-bar ATR signals; any Symbol
why_new_for_mis: Turns multi-strategy correlation and stacked USD/FX exposure into an explicit account-level sensor/gate MIS can query before sizing—orthogonal to single-chart price features.
quote: When the incoming signal belongs to a correlation group identified by its magic number and the account already holds an open position from the same group, the approved lot is automatically halved before being returned to the EA.

mechanism: Narrative guide to migrating MQL5 article archives into Algo Forge Shared Projects, UTF-8 commits, Releases, and README Markdown. No market-regime, volatility, or liquidity sensor is built.
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—developer tooling and documentation culture only.
quote: Switching to Algo Forge isn't just a change in how you store files; it's a new standard for professional activities.

mechanism: Classify each bar closeΔ vs PriceStep·_Point into up/down/flat; over EntropyPeriod compute normalized Shannon entropy H/log2(3); map H<0.35→TREND, 0.35–0.65→TRANSITION, >0.65→CHAOTIC (color histogram). Fast(20)/slow(100) entropy, divergence=fast−slow, and momentum=ΔH over MomentumPeriod enrich the regime label.
data_needed: Close series; EntropyPeriod/Fast/Slow/MomentumPeriod; PriceStep; optional daily reset of state counts.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a three-state information-theoretic regime from discretized price states rather than MA/ADX-style trend filters.
quote: When one movement type dominates (like mostly up moves in a strong trend), entropy becomes low, typically below 0.35, indicating structured, predictable market conditions. When movements are evenly distributed between up, down, and flat, entropy rises above 0.65, signaling chaotic, unpredictable market behavior.

mechanism: CompressionState=-1 when H falling and H<CompressionZone(0.30); =1 when H rising and H>DecompressionZone(0.50). Local min/max over CompressionBars track extremes. Information shock if H_t > 1.25·H_{t-1}; regime-shift marker when regime[i]≠regime[i-1]. Buy favors compress→decompress / fast>slow cross with H not chaotic; sell favors chaotic entry or strong negative divergence.
data_needed: Base entropy buffer; CompressionZone/DecompressionZone; CompressionBars; SignalThreshold.
why_new_for_mis: Compression/decompression of market uncertainty plus 25% entropy shocks are concrete change events MIS can use as breakout/risk gates.
quote: The indicator also detects “information shocks” (25%+ entropy spikes) and regime shifts.

mechanism: EA recomputes the same entropy stack on each tick/bar; IsBuySignal on fast/slow cross-up (with H<0.70), compressionBreakout (state==1 and 0.20<H<0.50), or decompressionEnd; IsSellSignal on cross-down (H>0.50), chaoticEntry (regime 0/1→2), strongDivergence, or compressionEnd with negative momentum. MinSignalGap sparsifies.
data_needed: Same entropy buffers as 21743; LotSize/SL/TP; MinSignalGap; ExtOnOppstTrd.
why_new_for_mis: Formalizes chaotic-regime entry and compression-breakout as executable, auditable change sensors—MIS can reuse the boolean event definitions without the trade wrapper.
quote: Additional triggers include transitions into chaotic regimes or the end of decompression phases accompanied by negative momentum.

mechanism: HTF base–impulse zones (impulse_range≥RatioMultiplier×base_range) filtered by Min/MaxZoneHeightPoints and optional zoneHeight≥0.5·ATR(14). Stop = zone edge ± StopBufferFactor·zoneHeight; lots from RiskPercent of balance. On impulsive violation (range≥ViolationMultiplier×zoneHeight and close beyond opposite edge) FlipZone demand↔supply and re-enter with FlipRiskPercent (default 0.5%). Flipped entries wait for pullback+engulfing/pin/inside-break.
data_needed: HTF OHLC (ZoneTimeframe e.g. H1); ATR; RiskPercent/FlipRiskPercent; ViolationMultiplier; chart M5–M15 execution.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Attach on M5–M15; ZoneTimeframe H1 recommended; any Symbol
why_new_for_mis: Treats flipped/violated liquidity zones as a distinct lower-confidence regime with automatic risk downshift—MIS can score zone lifecycle state, not just static S/D boxes.
quote: Reduced exposure is applied to zones that have already been tested or structurally violated, reflecting their lower reliability.

mechanism: Inside each HTF base candle, copy LTF highs/lows; FindSwings with swing_distance; classify ascending/descending/symmetrical triangle (flatness % + slopes), rectangle (≥2 touches each rail, range≤2% avg), or M/W (peak/valley depth factor). Prefer triangles over rectangles in DetectInternalBaseShape; also DetectTriangleOrigin on HTF. Labels + alerts carry Internal|Origin shape as zone-strength features.
data_needed: HTF zone start/end; LTF bars in interval (≥Geo_MinBars); Geo_TriangleTolerance/RectangleTolerance/MWDepthFactor/SwingDistance.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M5 chart with H1 zones (12 M5 bars/hour); also M1 (60 bars); Strategy Tester 2020.03 logs
why_new_for_mis: Converts subjective 'what's inside the base' into a reproducible geometry class MIS can use to rank liquidity-zone quality (triangle accumulation vs rectangle drift).
quote: The missing piece is the internal geometry of the base candle—the actual pattern that tells you whether the market accumulated with strength (triangle) or just drifted sideways (rectangle).

mechanism: SQLite DEALS/SIGNALS/EVENTS schema, prepared inserts with transactions, SQL aggregations by symbol/magic/hour, and an on-chart stats dashboard. Analyzes own trade history, not market microstructure or regimes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Dashboard examples cite XAGUSD/AUDUSD/EURUSD/GBPUSD deal stats
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—trade-journal / analytics infrastructure only.
quote: The trading journal is no longer a static file that needs to be exported, opened in a third-party program, and manually brought to a convenient format.

mechanism: Track active buy-side (swing high) and sell-side (swing low) with pivot strength rightLeftBars. Valid buy-side sweep: wick through level then close/open back below with upperWickRatio≥45%, OR dual-candle breach then bearish engulf reclaim. Mirror for sell-side. One-sweep-per-level via sweeps[]/violates[]; structural close-through without reclaim → violate and advance to next older swing.
data_needed: OHLC series; rightLeftBars; MIN_WICK_RATIO=45; swing arrays.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any Symbol/PERIOD_CURRENT (STF); chart demo of Liquidity Sweep Sentinel
why_new_for_mis: Dynamic (not fixed-window) STF sweep detector with wick-ratio + engulf confirmation and post-violation invalidation—cleaner liquidity-grab change events for MIS.
quote: Rather than relying solely on static wick logic, the indicator incorporates: Dynamic sweep detection, Wick-ratio validation, Dual-candle sweep detection (Engulfing pattern), One-sweep-per-level validation rule, Post-violation liquidity sweep invalidation.

mechanism: Build nodes from swing H/L (lookback N) that remain unbreached by later closes; drop same-type neighbors closer than 0.3·ATR. Edge cost = ATR-normalized |Δprice| + InpSpreadPenalty·(spread/ATR) + noise penalty if same-type. A* from nearest node to bias-aligned goal (within 8 ATR); trade only if directional up/down move ratio≥InpMinPathScore, total g≤InpMaxPathCost, and no opposing swing on path. TP=goal node, SL=opposite prior swing±ATR buffer.
data_needed: OHLC; ATR(InpATRPeriod); spread; swing lookback; path score/cost thresholds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H1 backtest 02 Feb–01 Apr 2026; any Symbol/_Period
why_new_for_mis: Maps structure to a weighted graph and scores the least-resistance path—MIS gets a continuous structural-efficiency/regime feature plus opposing-node blockade as a change filter.
quote: we turn validated swings into graph nodes, construct a weighted map (ATR‑normalized distance, spread, and noise penalties), and use the A* algorithm to find the optimal route for price.

mechanism: Load/filter MQL5 calendar by currency, CALENDAR_IMPORTANCE_HIGH, CALENDAR_TYPE_INDICATOR, and tier-1 event_code (NONFARM/CPI/GDP/RATE/…); treat event as active in a pre/post window (e.g. 15–30 min before, ~60 min after) via TimeTradeServer comparisons. Use as volatility/risk gate (reduce size / pause), not as directional actual>forecast trigger. Surprise = actual−forecast only after HasActual/HasForecast checks. Cache + CalendarValueLast(change_id); embed filtered .bin #resource for tester parity.
data_needed: MqlCalendarValue/Event/Country via API or resource; currency list; importance/code filters; server-time windows.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USD/EUR(/JPY) event exports; EURUSD M5 tester validation example; FX news generally
why_new_for_mis: Operationalizes macro calendar as a reproducible scheduled-volatility sensor with Live/Tester parity—MIS can gate other features around high-impact windows without scraping browsers.
quote: Golden rule: The calendar answers the question "When to expect increased volatility?", not "Which direction to trade?"

mechanism: On Close[] (newest-first), Calculate_d by variance heuristic (var1 vs 0.5/0.1·var0, optional d=2); Difference; grid ARMA p,q≤5 fit by SSE + Adam (AR/MA clipped ±0.99); pick min AICc; one-step forecast_diff then invert d and Round2Ticksize. Emits ARIMA(p,d,q) diagnostics + next-close forecast as a sequence feature.
data_needed: Recent closes (demo copies 5000 bars); tick size; max_p/max_q.
why_new_for_mis: Native AutoARIMA one-step price forecast with automatic d and AICc order selection—MIS can use forecast−last or residual as a lightweight sequence sensor without external Python.
quote: The implemented approach automates the full pipeline: (1) estimate differencing order d with a variance-based heuristic… (3) select the best model by corrected AIC (AICc), and (4) invert differencing… to produce a one-step price forecast.

mechanism: Confirm swing H/L with rightLeftBars neighbors; keep last two of each. getTrendDirection uses the time-dominant swing pair: newer highs → UP if high[0]>high[1] else DOWN; else use lows similarly; else RANGE. Close beyond active swing high/low marks break: labeled BOS if break continues currentTrend, else CHOCH; dashboard arrows show TREND_UP/DOWN/RANGE. New-bar-only engine.
data_needed: OHLC; rightLeftBars; last two swingHigh/swingLow structs.
why_new_for_mis: Pair-based adaptive BOS vs CHOCH labeling plus explicit RANGE state gives MIS a clean structure-regime and regime-change event stream from price alone.
quote: A close above the active swing high confirms a bullish structural break. A close below the active swing low confirms a bearish structural break. The broken swing is flagged, market context is classified as either BOS or CHOCH.
